news.title: Inferring the Host: A Bayesian Look at the Monty Hall Problem
news.dek:
"Always switch" is true for one particular host. Watch a few episodes and you can work out which host you've got. 
 The post  Inferring the Host: A Bayesian Look at the Monty Hall Problem  appeared first on  Towards Data Science .
news.aiSummary: The article applies Bayesian inference to the Monty Hall Problem, arguing that the standard advice to always switch is only valid for a specific type of host. By observing a few episodes, a player can deduce which host they are interacting with to determine the correct strategy.
